---
name: New rule proposal
about: Propose a new rule for the analysis engine
title: "[Rule] "
labels: rule
---

## Rule summary

One sentence describing what this rule checks.

## Category

Which category does this belong to? (documentation, testing, devops,
repository_hygiene, security_foundations, architecture_foundations,
ai_readiness)

## Evidence

What observable, verifiable fact in a repository should this rule check for?
(e.g. "a file named SECURITY.md exists at the repository root")

## Passing condition

When should this rule report `passed`?

## Failing condition

When should this rule report `failed`? What evidence should be shown to the
user in that case?

## Recommendation

If the rule fails, what actionable recommendation should be shown?

## Why this matters

Why is this worth checking? What risk or benefit does it relate to?
